# Profiles {#admin-profiles}

A **profile** selects which tool categories a Kailash system carries.
The image name encodes its profile (see [Install](install.qmd)):
`minimal` enables none of the catalogue, `redteam-ai` enables the AI
offense/defence lab set, `full` carries the complete live catalogue,
and `headless-agent` trades the desktop for CLI-only operation.

See [Install](install.qmd) for the image/profile mapping.

Categories are enabled declaratively in the system configuration —
there is no imperative package install step that drifts a system away
from its declaration. Rebuild against the same lock reproduces the
same tool set; enable more categories and rebuild to move up.
